is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigates Anopheles arabiensis, Anopheles funestus, and Anopheles gambiae s.l. / An. coluzzii (page 432, section 2.1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: No genotyping of target resistance markers was conducted in this study. Vgsc L1014F (L995F) is mentioned only as background literature describing the SENN-DDT colony (page 432, section 2.1: 'SENN-DDT is resistant to DDT, permethrin, deltamethrin, and malathion due to increased detoxification enzyme activity and fixation of the L1014F kdr mutation (Oliver & Brooke, 2013, 2014)').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype or allele counts, frequencies, or sample sizes for resistance markers are reported for any population in this paper.

african_field_population.evidence: Field-caught adult females of An. funestus were collected from human dwellings in Palmeíra, Mozambique (page 432, section 2.1) and wild An. gambiae s.l. entered experimental huts in M'bé, Côte d'Ivoire (page 433–434, section 2.5).

is_primary_study.evidence: The paper reports primary empirical laboratory assays, experimental hut trials, and transmission modelling.

sub_country_location.evidence: Specific sub-country locations are provided: Palmeíra, Mozambique (25°15′49.5″S, 32°52′13.8″E) and M’bé field station near Bouaké, Côte d’Ivoire (page 432–433).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collection dates/years for the field-collected mosquitoes used in the empirical assays are not reported in the text (only a reference to prior testing in 2013 is noted on page 432).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Standard experimental hut trials and behavioral laboratory assays conducted by the authors.

supplement.evidence: Supplementary information describes CDC bioassay data and model parameters, not resistance marker genotyping.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the lethal and sublethal impacts of LLIN exposure (Olyset and PermaNet 2.0) on blood-feeding and host-seeking behavior using resistant laboratory colonies (SENN-BASE, SENN-DDT, FUMOZ-BASE, FUMOZ-R, TONGS) and field-collected mosquitoes from Palmeíra (Mozambique) and M'bé (Côte d'Ivoire). No molecular genotyping of insecticide resistance markers was conducted.
exclusion_reasons: Does not genotype any target insecticide-resistance markers
